text_block_list.text:
Fu... ku... come... cellar... There... you
will...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I will?! Wait! Come back! Is this a
prophecy?!
What will I do in the cellar?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Flyin' fragalo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the academy when I
see
Matikanefukukitaru frenziedly
picking every
flower in sight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... P-please don't stop me! I must fulfill the prophecy I saw in my dream, to achieve happiness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look down at her feet to find a single
sheet of
paper. Scribbled on it are what
appear to be
drawings of flowers, a
dancer, some numbers, and
other various
things.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It isn't a doodle! It is a ritual diagram!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
While back home visiting my family, I
received a
divine message in a dream
telling me to search for
something in the
cellar... When I went, I
discovered this
paper!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe the prophecy came
true?! The
ritual depicted in this diagram
must reveal
something truly miraculous!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Except I'm having trouble understanding it. Still, I will eventually decipher its contents to successfully perform the ritual, and soon be blessed beyond imagination!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly dashes away, brimming
with
excitement. Worried about what
she might be
getting up to, I quickly
follow.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
La la la... ♪ Chrysanthemum flowers,
pluckity
plucked... ♪ Boiled with a dash
of—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho, chrysanthemum flowers! And
actually, they
look quite like the flowers
in my ritual diagram.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In that case... Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah?! F-Fuku?! Those are mine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Burp... Finally, with this... Blegh! No... I have to hold it in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next is... to run on the track
while
dancing! The ritual diagram's word
is absolute!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh, Fukukitaru's up to funny business
again!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...When will we get our chance to run?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to stop Matikanefukukitaru to no
avail. She
continues her rampage
throughout the academy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand your side of the story.
However, I
cannot overlook the fact that
you ignored a
trainer's warnings and
caused trouble for the
other students.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I'm really, really sorry...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... I was feeling lucky, but ended
up with
great misfortune... What do I
do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course it... Well, it probably is? I
mean, I think
so, at least. G-give me just
a second!
choice_data_list: ……本当にそれ、儀式図なのかな？

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your dad and grandma don't
know
anything about a ritual diagram in
the cellar
either. We don't keep any of
our Shinto materials
down there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like neither Mom, Dad, nor
Granny
knows about it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What could it possibly beee?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: How could no one have any clue?! Someone must have hidden it away there! Who could it have been?! Who?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's no waaay nobody knows!
Aaargh!
Someone tell me what this iiiis!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp! A secret spell for extreme happiness?!
choice_data_list: 最高にハッピーな秘術かも！？
……封印しておくべきもの、とか

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense, I think?! If it's a secret
spell of
the highest order, no wonder
nobody knows
about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aww, of course! I made all this fuss for
nothing! I'll
be back tomorrow to solve
this riddle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel a kind of respect for
how
quickly Matikanefukukitaru gets
right back on her
feet.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Was that a black cat that just passed by?! Is it a sign of bad things to come?! Are the gods telling me I shouldn't stick my nose into this any further?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eek! Great Shiraoki, please save meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She runs off before I can even say a
word, leaving
me stupefied.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! I knew it had to be something
like that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, I must return the paper to the
cellar! But
first, I shall seal away any
evils! Foonjarga, be
forever gone! Come
back, no no!
Sigh... Really? But... one day you'll find... I know... you will...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh? I just felt a wave of warmth wash
over!
Could it have been the spirit of
someone passed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The best I can muster is a puzzled nod. I
could
have sworn I heard a voice... I part
ways with her,
leaving the mystery
unanswered.
